in_marathi.name: Devsuransh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's will, divine descent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devsuransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devsuransh is derived from the words ‘Dev’ (God) and ‘Suransh’ (descend). This name signifies the divine will of God and the descent of a god in human form.
